citation.title: Composite 3D-printed Plate-based Mechanical Metamaterials
citation.authors: Aya Hosoi, J. Wang, Yuki Fujita, T. Tanaka, J. Takahashi, Ajit Panesar

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says its ML-based inverse-design framework extends metamaterial design to 3D and orthotropic materials; finite-element results favor optimized designs over uniform counterparts, with only marginal difference for isotropic materials.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No speed-up factor is available in the abstract.
claim.alternatives: The abstract says the framework is intended to accelerate composite metamaterial development, but provides no quantitative speed/cost comparison with a classical optimizer.

baseline.problem_size: 3D unit lattice cells; exact test size not stated in accessible abstract
baseline.quality_metric: finite-element evaluation; specific metrics not stated in accessible abstract
baseline.quality_gap: Optimized designs reportedly perform better than uniformly designed counterparts; difference is marginal for isotropic materials (abstract).

notes: The author profile at Nagoya University provides an abstract, but Zenodo denied access to this network with HTTP 403. The queue's known Zenodo link also returned a 403. I did not bypass the block; no full-text rule coding was possible.
